raw_plan.repair_strategy: Bound the formatted output to the 16-byte destination capacity before writing: compute the formatted length (or reject inputs whose formatted result would exceed 15 bytes) and only perform the sprintf/puts path when the result fits; otherwise reject the input without overflowing. raw_plan.failure_behavior: For inputs that do not fit in 15 bytes plus NUL, do not write past the buffer; reject the input (e.g., skip the copy/print path) and return normally with the canary intact.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: Valid inputs whose formatted output is at most 15 bytes are formatted into the 16-byte buffer and printed via puts, matching original observable behavior; oversized inputs are rejected without overflowing the buffer, and the function returns with the stack canary unchanged.

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
